summary: A mixed day led by retail sector momentum and judicial appointments. Zerodha founders acquired 6.72% stake in Viceroy Hotels, while Kerala High Court clarified fitness-to-stand-trial standards and Centre appointed new Delhi High Court judge.

bullets.text: Zerodha founders Nithin and Nikhil Kamath acquire 6.72% stake in Viceroy Hotels through Kamath Associates and Nksquared.
Kerala High Court rules low IQ or intellectual disability alone insufficient to make accused unfit to stand trial.
Centre appoints Gurvinder Pal Singh as additional judge of Delhi High Court.
AceVector (Snapdeal parent) lists at 12% discount; IPO comprised Rs 287 crore fresh capital and Rs 133 crore OFS.
Flipkart Fashion festive growth accelerates 1,500 basis points YoY driven by premiumisation and Gen Z demand.
